about.label: About me
about.title: Roughly this
about.bio1: San Juan, Argentina. The only one in my family born there, so I talk funny even at home.
about.bio2: I've been programming for a few years. I co-founded Pulso Studio, built a newspaper that writes itself and a couple of systems people use every day without knowing I exist.
about.bio3: Lately I'm into light, sensors and projectors. Not sure where it's going. That's the fun part.

skills.collab: Breaking things to see how they work.
skills.async: Listening to more music than I should while I code.

pulso.desc: Running a digital studio for professionals and small businesses. Building websites and landing pages focused on lead generation, with form integrations, email automation, and light analytics. Hands-on with clients across content architecture and messaging.

ant.desc: Built and maintained corporate dashboards and internal web applications in an Agile/Scrum environment. Worked across the full stack: React + Redux + Material UI on the frontend, C# + .NET + Entity Framework on the backend, SQL Server for data, and Docker for deployment. Used Jira and Bitbucket for team collaboration.

coneq.desc: Developed the corporate site for an engineering and construction company. Implemented a multilanguage system with react-i18next, interactive map with LeafletJS, contact form via EmailJS, and full responsive design across mobile, tablet, and desktop.

qxm.desc: Built landing pages and interactive dashboards for a digital HR platform. Worked with React and Angular on the frontend, collaborating with a NestJS + SQL backend team.

brief.desc: Your daily Brief  a news aggregator that reads multiple RSS feeds, categorizes and summarizes each article with AI, and publishes a clean, multi-language digest. The whole content pipeline runs on its own: a scheduled n8n workflow pulls new articles from 5 RSS sources in parallel, loops through each one to categorize and summarize it with AI, saves it to Supabase, and wraps up by emailing a daily news digest  no manual intervention. Built with React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS 4, and Supabase.

pulso.desc: Multi-agency CRM (formerly an internal tool called Pulso CRM, now offered to other agencies with their own branding): clients, agile project management with drag-and-drop kanban, finance, and docs. Built with React 19, Vite, Supabase (Postgres + Auth + RLS), and Zustand.

crew.desc: SaaS platform for gym management: QR check-in, class scheduling, and payments, with pricing plans and per-gym branding. Built with Vite, React, and Supabase.

agent.desc: Conversational AI agent for B2B sales automation, integrated with CRM and messaging.

landing.desc: Marketing landing page for MonteCa, auto and fleet insurance advisors: quote request form, services section, and lead capture. Built with React 19 and Vite, deployed on Vercel.

insurance.desc: Internal management system for Monteca, insurance advisors: centralized client, vehicle, and policy administration, always available. Built with React 19, Vite, and Supabase RLS.

scraper.desc: Node.js CLI tool that scrapes Mountain Project for climbing route data. Uses Playwright for dynamic rendering and outputs structured JSON.
